# Azure App Service PHP 8.1
Support for PHP 8.1 on Azure App Services ends on Dec 31, 2025. 

For more information, visit https://www.php.net/supported-versions.php

content.query:
resources 
| where type =~ "microsoft.web/sites"
| extend phpVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion)
| where phpVersion contains "8.1"
| project name, location, resourceGroup, phpVersion, subscriptionId
content.title: Azure App Service PHP 8.1

content.json:
-----

# Azure Storage TLS 1.0 & 1.1

Support for TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 for Azure Storage Accounts ends on February 3, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/azurepaasblog/azure-storage---tls-1-0-and-1-1-retirement/4281140.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts'
| extend minimumTlsVersion = tostring(parse_json(properties).minimumTlsVersion)
| extend tlsConfigured = iff(isnull(minimumTlsVersion) or trim(' ', minimumTlsVersion) == '', 'UNSET', minimumTlsVersion)
| where tlsConfigured in~ ('UNSET', 'TLS1_0', 'TLS1_1')
| project id, resourceGroup, name, location, minimumTlsVersion = tlsConfigured, subscriptionId
content.title: TLS for Azure Storage Accounts

content.json:
------

# Windows Server 2019 on Azure Kubernetes Service

AKS nodes running Windows Server 2019 will be retired as of March 1, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/containers/announcing-the-3-year-retirement-of-windows-server-2019-on-azure-kubernetes-serv/3777341.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'
| extend pools = properties.agentPoolProfiles
| mv-expand pool = pools
| where tolower(tostring(pool.osType)) == 'windows'
| where tolower(tostring(pool.osSKU)) == 'windows2019'
| project subscriptionId, resourceGroup, clusterName = name,
          poolName = tostring(pool.name),
          osType   = tostring(pool.osType),
          osSKU    = tostring(pool.osSKU)
| summarize poolsWithWindows2019 = count(), poolNames = make_set(poolName)
          by subscriptionId, resourceGroup, clusterName
| order by subscriptionId, resourceGroup, clusterName
content.title: Windows Server 2019 on AKS

# Application Gateway v1 

Application Gateway v1 will be retired as of April 28, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/updates?id=application-gateway-v1-will-be-retired-on-28-april-2026-transition-to-application-gateway-v2.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways'
| extend sku = tostring(properties.sku.name)
| where sku in~ ('Standard','WAF')            // v1 SKUs only
| project name, resourceGroup, location
content.title: Application Gateway v1

# Azure App Service running Node 20 LTS

Azure App Service running Node 20 LTS will be retired as of March 30, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/updates?id=485072.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| extend nodeVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion)
| where nodeVersion contains '20'
| project name, resourceGroup, location, kind, nodeVersion
content.title: App Services running Node 20 LTS

# VPN Gateway Non-AZ SKUs

VPN Gateways that are not deployed as Zone Redundant will be retired as of September 30, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/updates?id=vpngw1-5-non-az-skus-will-be-retired-on-30-september-2026.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways'
| where properties.sku.name !endswith 'AZ'
| project name, resourceGroup, location, properties.sku.name, properties.gatewayType, subscriptionId
content.title: VPN Gateways not Zone Redundant

# Application Insights URL Ping Test

Application Insights availability tests that use 'ping' will be retired as of September 30, 2026. 

For more information, visit https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/app/availability?tabs=standard#types-of-availability-tests.

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.insights/webtests"
| extend testKind = tostring(properties.Kind)
| where testKind == "ping"
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location
content.title: App Insights URL Ping Tests
